+def test_stderr_visible_while_running(qtbot, proc, py_proc, message_mock,
+                                      caplog):
+    proc._output_messages = True
+    cmd, args = py_proc("""
+        import sys, time
+        print('failure detail', file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
+        time.sleep(0.5)
+    """)
+
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR, 'message'):
+        proc.start(cmd, args)
+        qtbot.wait_until(lambda: len(message_mock.messages) == 1, timeout=5000)
+        assert proc.outcome.running
+        assert message_mock.messages[0].level == usertypes.MessageLevel.error
+        assert message_mock.messages[0].text == 'failure detail'
+
+        with qtbot.wait_signal(proc.finished, timeout=5000):
+            pass
+
+    assert len(message_mock.messages) == 2
+    assert message_mock.messages[1].level == usertypes.MessageLevel.error
+    assert message_mock.messages[1].text == 'failure detail'
